t: An open audio board that turns sensors into sound with almost no delay.
steps: Buy a Bela Gem starter kit from the Bela shop. It includes the PocketBeagle 2 host board.
Prepare the microSD card with the steps in the Bela get started guide.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB cable.
Open the Bela IDE in your web browser.
Plug headphones into the audio output.
Run a basic audio example from the IDE and listen.
Try the oscilloscope in the IDE to see the wave.
Wire a knob or sensor to an analog input and change the example.
meta: Wild Open. From $188. A few stores.
